title: Commit or Abstain? System One Decision Models, LLMs, and Missing Legal Authority
abstract: arXiv:2610.29961v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Given the enormous number of claims to be checked, verifiable legal AI requires scalable, cost-effective models that answer the practical needs of law. System One decision models are built on large language models but, instead of generating text, return a calibrated probability for each option. This suits the verification of legal authority, where the question is closed: a given holding, or none of them. We test whether such models abstain when the correct authority is missing. We extend CaseHOLD with an abstention condition in which the correct holding is replaced in 1,670 of 5,314 items, and compare four decision models with six generative LLMs. When no option is correct, generative LLMs still pick one in 38-86% of items; the most cautious decision model does so in 30%. translated_title: 抉择还是弃权？系统一决策模型、大语言模型与缺失的法律依据
translated_abstract: 鉴于需要核查的法律主张数量庞大，可验证的法律人工智能需要可扩展、高性价比且能满足法律实践需求的模型。系统一决策模型构建于大语言模型之上，但不生成文本，而是为每个选项返回一个经过校准的概率。这非常适合法律依据的核查场景，因为该问题是封闭式的：要么是某个给定的裁判要旨，要么都不是。我们测试了当正确的法律依据缺失时，此类模型是否会选择弃权。我们对CaseHOLD数据集进行了扩展，加入了一个弃权条件，即在5,314条数据中的1,670条里将正确的裁判要旨替换掉，并比较了四个决策模型与六个生成式大语言模型的表现。当没有任何选项正确时，生成式大语言模型仍在38%-86%的条目中强行选择一个选项；而最谨慎的决策模型仅在30%的条目中这样做。在标准CaseHOLD数据集上，一个决策模型以仅为生成式大语言模型1/55的成本达到了与其最佳水平相当的表现（88.1% vs. 88.2%）。只有当决策模型……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 系统一决策模型在正确的法律依据缺失时能够可靠地弃权（错误作答率仅30%，远低于生成式大语言模型的38%-86%），并以仅为生成式大语言模型1/55的成本达到同等准确率，为可验证的法律AI提供了高性价比且诚实的解决方案。
en_tdlr: System One decision models reliably abstain when the correct legal authority is missing (erroneously answering in only 30% of cases versus 38-86% for generative LLMs) while matching the best generative LLM's accuracy at 1/55 of the cost, offering a scalable and honest solution for verifiable legal AI.
